scope: Retain the Axkva Min Nandina and Gorvo encounter while making Nandina's authored 50000-point heal authoritative instead of allowing the post-NGE healing-reduction statistic to rewrite it.

eraEvidence.basis: The expansion encounter is intentionally retained, but Publish 14.1 player progression has no expertise_healing_reduction statistic. The command handler supplies an authored fixed heal amount and the live AI profile supplies its cadence.
findings: heroic_axkva_min.tab spawns Nandina and Gorvo together and respawns both through resetNandina.
heroic_axkva_nandina invokes nandina_heal every ten seconds with full authored AI-profile chance, and the command and combat-data rows route it into combat_actions.java.
nandina_heal resolves the live spawn_id gorvo, refuses an invalid or dead target, heals Gorvo, and plays its retained client effect.
The removed arithmetic was the final Java consumer of expertise_healing_reduction and could reduce the authored 50000-point encounter heal according to an NGE-derived stat on Gorvo.

buildEvidence.lineEndingPolicy: the touched combat_actions.java blob retained the repository's declared LF policy
buildEvidence.sourceTest: passed; command and combat routing, live AI cadence, initial/reset spawns, creature definitions, Gorvo resolution, exact authored heal, and client effect were authenticated with zero Java healing-reduction expertise consumers
buildEvidence.focusedJavaCompile: passed in an ephemeral in-memory output directory that was removed immediately; emitted combat_actions bytecode retained nandina_heal and 50000 with no expertise_healing_reduction symbol

auditBoundary.closedInThisMilestone: No server Java path can consume expertise_healing_reduction, and Nandina's retained heal now always uses its authored 50000-point value.
auditBoundary.preserved: Axkva instance spawns and resets, Nandina and Gorvo scripts, AI cadence, command/combat routing, Gorvo lookup and dead-target admission, healing call, and client effect remain available.
auditBoundary.notClaimedComplete: NGE healing-reduction rows remain as inert later-content data while player NGE command/skill admission is retired; other expertise families remain subject to the wider PRE-CU precedence audit.
